Entries.Text:
Merge another project's text into your current project.

Each entry is compared with vanilla:
- Entries only the other project has are added.
- Entries only the other project changed are updated.
- Entries the other project left vanilla keep your text.
- Entries both projects changed are conflicts.

Analyse to review the changes, then Apply. The merge is one step in Undo History.
Where to merge text from: another project, a mod folder, or a text export (JSON).
No other projects for this game. To merge a downloaded mod, choose Mod Folder instead.
Another Smithbox project for the same game.
A mod's folder, laid out like the game's (for example msg/engus/item.msgbnd.dcx). You can pick the mod's root folder, its msg folder or a language folder. No project is needed.

A JSON file made with the Text Editor's Export. It is merged into the container it was exported from, or the selected container for older exports. Entries missing from an export are not treated as removed, since an export can hold only some entries.
Choose the folder of the mod to merge from.
Choose the JSON text export to merge from.
Options are saved. Changing the languages clears the current analysis.
Only text in the ticked languages is merged. With none ticked, the primary language is merged. Changing this clears the current analysis.
A text export is merged into the language it was exported from.
When both projects changed an entry:

A conflict is an entry that both projects changed from vanilla (or both added) with different text, or a vanilla entry you deleted that the other project changed.

This sets the starting choice for each conflict. You can change any of them before applying.
Conflicts start set to your text.
Conflicts start set to the other project's text.
Conflicts start unresolved. Apply is enabled once you have chosen for each one.
Compare the selected project with yours and vanilla, and list the changes. Nothing is changed yet.
Apply the ticked changes and conflict choices to your project, as one undo step.

Tick or untick FMGs and entries, and choose for each conflict. Click an ID to show the entry in the editor. Hover a row to see the vanilla, your and their text.
